questions.explain: Scale first: 2(1, 3) = (2, 6). Then subtract component by component: (2 − 4, 6 − 1) = (−2, 5).
Multiply matching entries and add: 2 − 2 + 0 = 0. A zero dot product means the vectors are perpendicular.

questions.stem: Let $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&0&2\\0&1&3\end{pmatrix}$ and $x=\begin{pmatrix}1\\2\\3\end{pmatrix}$. What is the second entry of $Ax$?
questions.explain: The second entry is row 2 of A dotted with x: 0·1 + 1·2 + 3·3 = 11.
